title: Authenticate encrypted packets
responsibility: Seal packet bytes with AES-GCM and bind them to direction, counter and continuation flag.

inputs.name: sealPacket.context
inputs.description: AES-GCM key, d2h or h2d direction, packet counter and continuation flag.

inputs.name: openPacket.context
inputs.description: Matching key, direction, counter and continuation flag expected for this packet.

inputs.name: openPacket.data
inputs.description: Unpadded base64url ciphertext followed by its authentication tag.

outputs.name: sealPacket
outputs.description: Base64url ciphertext and 16-byte tag using a nonce derived from the counter.

errors.name: SecureFailure
errors.description: Any decoding, parameter or authentication failure while opening becomes SecureFailure with reason tag.
